candidate_reports.remark: Storm spotter on Panther Creek reported 3/4 of rain the past 24 hrs. There is a mudslide/rockslide just upstream from the Shoup store blocking the road until the USFS gets out here and clears it all
Numerous debris flows covered Salmon River Road east of Shoup_ with additional debris flows reported along Panther Creek Road. MRMS radar estimated rainfall rates of 0.25 to 0.35 inches in roughly 15
Anaconda Bowman Field Airport AWOS K3U3 reported southwest wind sustained at 40 mph with gusts to 58 mph. At 1331 it reported a sustained wind of 44 mph. So far there have been power outages reported
Avon North MDT sensor also reported 48 mph sustained wind.
Reports of several large and mature trees down at the Holy Cross Cemetery.
Reports of large tree down at Highland View Golf Course. Time estimated based on other reports in the area.
Public report of large Aspen tree down with damage to a fence. Time estimated based on other reports in the area.
